UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated BillRail user profile, T&C legal consent state, and client security preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

termsAccepted.description: Whether the user has accepted the Indian BillRail Terms and Conditions.

termsVersion.description: Accepted Terms and Conditions version identifier (e.g., v1.0-IN).

screenShieldEnabled.description: Whether FLAG_SECURE screenshot protection is enabled.

biometricConfirmEnabled.description: Whether device lock / biometric check before bill payment is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedBiller.title: SavedBiller
SavedBiller.description: A user-saved BBPS biller with masked identifier (never stores raw card PAN or CVV).

providerName.description: Biller provider name (e.g., BESCOM, HDFC Bank Credit Card).

billerCode.description: NPCI Bharat Connect / BBPOU biller identifier.

nickname.description: User-chosen short label for the biller.

maskedIdentifier.description: Consumer ID, mobile number, vehicle registration, or masked last-4 card digits. Raw PANs are prohibited.

lastBillAmountPaise.description: Latest fetched or expected bill amount in INR paise.

autopayReminder.description: Whether due-date reminders are enabled for this biller.

BillTransaction.title: BillTransaction
BillTransaction.description: Record of a regulated BBPS / UPI Intent or Tokenized Payment Aggregator bill payment.

billerId.description: Saved biller document ID or 'direct' for one-off payments.

amountPaise.description: Principal bill payment amount in INR paise.

convenienceFeePaise.description: Regulated convenience fee in INR paise (0 for UPI).

tokenRef.description: UPI reference or RBI tokenized PA reference; never a raw card PAN.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest status update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

GrievanceTicket.title: GrievanceTicket
GrievanceTicket.description: BBPS / RBI dispute and T+1 to T+5 auto-refund tracking ticket linked to a transaction.

transactionId.description: Document ID of the associated BillTransaction.

complaintRef.description: Bharat Connect / Grievance Officer complaint reference number.

slaWindow.description: Expected settlement/refund SLA window (T+1 to T+5 Business Days).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when complaint was raised (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest complaint update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: User profile, T&C consent ledger, and client security configuration.

/users/{userId}/billers/{billerId}.description: User-owned saved BBPS billers with zero raw PAN storage.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: User-owned BBPS and UPI/Tokenized PA bill payment receipts.

/users/{userId}/grievances/{ticketId}.description: User-owned BBPS dispute and T+1 to T+5 refund tracking tickets.
